definitions.usage: continually, fugitive, × make, to (go) up and down, be gone away, (be) move(-able, -d), be promoted, reel, remove, scatter, set, shake, sift, stagger, to and fro, be vagabond, wag, (make) wander (up and down).
definitions.full: H5128. nua נוּעַ verb quiver, wave, waver, tremble, totter (Late Hebrew Pilpal נִעְנַע shake , Aramaic נוּעַ waver, stagger (rare); Arabic , bend (of boughs), see commotus fuit (of id. ), so Kam Frey; also change , kind, species, variety ; Di compare Ethiopic hunt ); — Qal Perfect נָ֫עוּ Job 28:4 +; וְנָע֫וּ Amos 4:8 2 t.; Imperfect וַיָּ֫נַע Isa 7:2-3 ;feminine singular תָּנוּעַ 24:20 ; אֲנוּעֲךָ 2Sam 15:20 Kt (but read Qr Hiph`il q. v.); יָנ֫וּעוּ Psa 109:10 ; יְנוּע֑וּן 59:16 Kt (so read; not Qr Hiph`il), etc.; Infinitive absolute Isa 24:20 ; Psa 109:10 ; construct נוּעַ Judg 9:9 3 t.; נוֺעַ Isa 7:2 ; Participle נָע Gen 4:12 , 14 ; נָעִים Prov 22:19 ; נָעוֺת 1Sam 1:13 : — 1 wave , of trees, followed by עַל Judg 9:9 , 11 , 13 followed by מִמְּנֵי of cause Isa 7:2 ; quiver, vibrate , of lips 1Sam 1:13 ; swing (to and fro) of miners Job 28:4 (|| דלל ); stagger like drunkard, of mariners in storm Psa 107:27 (|| חגג ), compare Isa 29:9 (|| שׁכר ); hence be unstable , figurative of ways of harlot Prov 5:6 ; tremble , of doorposts, Isa 6:4 (followed by מִן causative ), idols 19:1 (followed by מִמְּנֵי ), earth 24:20 (|| התנודד ), people Exod 20:18 (E); figurative of heart Isa 7:2 . 2 totter, go tottering (faint and uncertain) Lam 4:14 4:15 (|| נוּץ ), Amos 8:12 (|| שׁוטט ); as beggars Psa 109:10 (|| שִׁאֵל ), compare 59:16 ; Amos 4:8 followed by אֶלֿ ; participle vagabond Gen 4:12 , 14 (both || נָד ); figurative = err, sin , Jer 14:10 . Niph`al Imperfect יִנּוֺעַ Amos 9:9 be tossed about (of corn) in a sieve; יִנּוֺעוּ id. , of bulwarks as fig-trees Nahum 3:12 (|| נפל ). Hiph`il Perfect 3feminine singular הֵנִ֫יעָה 2Kin 19:21 = Isa 37:22 ; וַהֲנִָֽעוֺתִ֫י Amos 9:9 ; Imperfect יָנִיעַ Zeph 2:15 ; jussive יָ֫נַע 2Kin 23:18 ; אֲנִיעֲךָ 2Sam 15:20 Qr (compare Qal ); יְנִיעוּן Psa 109:25 + 59:16 Qr (read Kt Qal q. v. ), etc.; Imperative suffix הֲנִיעֵ֫מוֺ Psa 59:12 ; — 1 toss about Amos 9:9 subject ׳י , object Israel followed by בַּגּוֺיִם (compare Niph`al ). 2 shake, cause to totter: = set me tottering Dan 10:10 on my knees and hands ; especially shake or wag the head, in mockery 2Kin 19:21 = Isa 37:22 (|| לעג בוז, ) compare Psa 22:8 ; 109:25 ; followed by עַלֿ Job 16:4 ( ר ׳בְּמוֺ [Ges § 119q ]), also Lam 2:15 (|| שׁרק ), Zeph 2:15 יָדוֺ (|| id. ), [see also Ecclus 12:18; Ecclus 13:7 ( ׳בְּר )]. 3 ( shake ), disturb , bones of dead 2Kin 23:18 . 4 cause to wander Num 32:13 (J); 2Sam 15:20 (followed by ללכת ); Psa 59:12 (|| הוריד , for which Lag Proph. Chald. xlviii. proposes הניד ).
